module_summary: Ethernet frame transmitter that latches parallel header fields, serializes them byte-by-byte via a pointer, then forwards the payload stream, all through a skid-buffered AXI-stream output.

anchors.name: send_eth_header_reg
anchors.why: Controller state: serializing the 14-byte Ethernet header

anchors.name: send_eth_payload_reg
anchors.why: Controller state: forwarding payload stream until tlast

anchors.name: ptr_reg
anchors.why: Header byte pointer selecting which field byte is output

anchors.name: s_eth_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Header valid; with ready latches header fields and starts frame

anchors.name: s_eth_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Header ready, asserted when neither header nor payload is being sent

anchors.name: s_eth_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Payload stream valid; advances payload transfer

anchors.name: s_eth_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Payload stream ready, asserted only in payload phase with output room

anchors.name: s_eth_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Payload bytes forwarded to output after header

anchors.name: s_eth_payload_axis_tlast
anchors.why: Payload end marker terminating payload phase

anchors.name: eth_dest_mac_reg
anchors.why: Latched destination MAC held while header is serialized

anchors.name: eth_src_mac_reg
anchors.why: Latched source MAC held while header is serialized

anchors.name: eth_type_reg
anchors.why: Latched EtherType held while header is serialized

anchors.name: s_eth_dest_mac
anchors.why: Parallel destination MAC header field input

anchors.name: store_eth_hdr
anchors.why: Load enable capturing header fields on header handshake

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata_int
anchors.why: Internal output byte mux: header field bytes or payload data

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output stream valid from skid output register

anchors.name: m_axis_tready
anchors.why: Output stream ready controlling skid buffer transfers

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Output frame bytes from skid output register

anchors.name: busy
anchors.why: Busy level while header or payload is being transmitted

anchors.name: shift_eth_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Payload alignment shifter output; passthrough when header offset is zero

anchors.name: shift_eth_payload_axis_extra_cycle_reg
anchors.why: Extra flush cycle flag for misaligned payload tail (unused at offset 0)

anchors.name: save_eth_payload_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Saved previous payload beat used by alignment shifter

anchors.name: transfer_in_save
anchors.why: Load enable saving current payload beat for alignment

anchors.name: flush_save
anchors.why: Clears saved beat state at end of frame

anchors.name: m_axis_tready_int_reg
anchors.why: Registered internal ready gating header advance and skid stores

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Skid buffer output register

anchors.name: temp_m_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Skid temp register holding a beat when output stalls

anchors.name: store_axis_int_to_output
anchors.why: Load enable: internal beat into output register

anchors.name: store_axis_int_to_temp
anchors.why: Load enable: internal beat into temp register

anchors.name: store_axis_temp_to_output
anchors.why: Load enable: temp register into output register

groups.name: Header serializer
groups.description: Latched header fields emitted byte-by-byte by pointer onto internal stream

groups.name: Payload aligner
groups.description: Shifts payload to align after header; passthrough at byte width

groups.name: Output skid buffer
groups.description: Output and temp registers providing registered AXI-stream backpressure
